article.title: Locativo especial -у en лесу/саду: reconocimiento
article.chapter: Preposicional y segundo locativo — Предложный падеж и второй предложный

claims.summary: The special locative is restricted to a small group of nouns and indicates location with в/на; lexical membership is dictionary-specific.
Gramota documents в лесу and contrasts it with о лесе.
Cornell documents the location/about contrast в шкафу versus о шкафе.
